newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-SAMPRAS LEADS FUND RAISER FOR GULLIKSON FOUNDATION.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SAMPRAS LEADS FUND RAISER FOR GULLIKSON FOUNDATION.

text.p: World number one Pete Sampras will be joined by Andre Agassi, Jim Courier and John McEnroe for a fund raising tennis exhibition at Madison Square Garden December 20 to benefit the Tim and Tom Gullikson Foundation.
The Foundation honours Tim Gullikson, 44, who coached Sampras for three years before his death from brain cancer last May, and assists brain tumour patients and their families.

"It will be very emotional," Sampras said by phone Wednesday from Florida at a Madison Square Garden news conference. "It's not easy. Time kinda of heals everything but it won't be the same without Tim in my life."
Organisers hope to raise at least $500,000.
"I think he will be smiling down at us," U.S. Davis Cup captain Tom Gullikson said of his twin brother.
None of the players are getting paid for the round-robin exhibition.
"These things are easy to say yes to," said McEnroe.
